title: Fancy UI registry index
description: The document served at /r/index.json: every installable component as a lightweight summary. Each item's `url` resolves to a document described by https://ui.particle.academy/schema/registry-item.json. Reference: https://ui.particle.academy/docs/registry

homepage.description: Where the registry's human documentation lives.

version.description: The kit version this index describes: the one asked for with `?version=`, or the current kit when omitted.

slug.description: A registry item name: lower-case kebab-case, unique across the registry.

package.description: The Fancy package the item comes from. Informational: the bundle is self-contained.

files.description: How many source files the item's bundle vendors. Zero means it vendors none and is installed as a package instead.

url.description: The item's full bundle, relative to the registry's origin.

since.description: First kit version the item exists in. Absent: it has always been here.

until.description: Last kit version the item exists in. Absent: still current.
